question: Can you upgrade a wastewater plant's switchgear?
html:
Yes. Electrical work inside wastewater plants is the core of what Horton Electrical Services brings to CET, and we can scope a switchgear upgrade. Our data does not list past switchgear jobs one by one, so we confirm scope plant by plant.

Where we work today

  • Horton is our Connecticut add-on, announced Sep 15, 2026. It brings Connecticut wastewater-plant relationships (CET public filings; CET growth plan).
  • Our growth plan points Horton at 62 funded or requested plant and pump-station projects across CT, MA and RI (CET growth plan).
  • At large plants our role is usually electrical subcontracting. We often pair it with NuWave efficiency work, for example on aeration, which is a plant's biggest energy load (CET wastewater-plant targets).

Plants with funded or requested work

PlantProjectValue
New Haven East Shore STPWet-weather and odor-control upgrade; process-air-compressor request$82M; $19.2M
Hartford WPCFSludge screening and equalization$24.3M
Norwalk WPCFFinal settling tanks; green aeration request$26M; $48M
MWRA Deer IslandClarifier #2$289M

(CET wastewater-plant targets)

  • These are total project values, not CET's electrical share.
  • Our data does not show how much of any project is switchgear.

What we confirm before quoting

  • Whether the switchgear sits inside a funded project or would be a standalone job.
  • The engineer's specification and bid documents for that plant.
  • Plant size and context. Design flow for 175 CT, MA and RI plants is in our nightly snapshot (EPA wastewater-plant compliance).

What our data can't answer

  • Price, lead time or crew size for a switchgear job. None of these are in our data. Horton's job records and supplier quotes would answer them.
  • Permit or regulatory questions. The plant's engineer or counsel should handle those.

Each plant electrical job opens the door to the SCADA and pump-station monitoring contracts the growth plan relies on to reach a ~25% recurring service mix by month 36 (est.; CET growth plan).

Next actions

  1. Pull Horton's job history and list switchgear and electrical-distribution references by plant and year.
  2. Review New Haven, Hartford and Norwalk bid documents for electrical-distribution scope and the CET share.
  3. Tag switchgear-related scope across the 183-plant target list (CET wastewater-plant targets).
  4. Build a standard switchgear capability sheet that covers Horton and NuWave, for plant engineers.
